[Story]
Li Hua is a photographer, he is taking cover photos for a magazine. During the shooting process, he finds a very unique shooting angle, but this requires him to climb to a higher position. At this time, his assistant Xiao Zhang runs to tell him that his favorite photography exhibition is about to start. Li Hua knows that if he leaves to watch the exhibition now, he may miss this shooting opportunity. At the same time, the editor of the magazine calls to urge him to complete the shooting work as soon as possible.

[Question]
What does Li Hua choose to do after receiving the message from assistant Xiao Zhang?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He goes to watch the photography exhibition immediately.
B. He asks Xiao Zhang to help climb to a high place to take pictures.
C. He replies to the editor that he needs more time to complete the shooting.
D. He continues the current shooting.
